message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large red serif letters at the top. Above it, text reads "LAPORAN KHUSUS TRANSFORMASI UANG" and "JEJAK PEMBUNUH PENDETA DI PAPUA". Below the title, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in small black letters.

The central scene features a winding line of yellow trucks with red covers trailing from the foreground into the distance. In the foreground, two men in black t-shirts and blue pants lean against the front truck. The man on the left wears a tan vest with a green emblem; the man on the right wears sunglasses and a shirt with a circular orange and blue logo. Red plastic barriers sit on the ground in front of the lead truck.

In the background, a large black cargo ship sits on a pale sea under a light blue sky. To the left, large bold black text reads "INVESTIGASI: JATAH PREMAN BUAH IMPOR," followed by a paragraph of smaller black text. A barcode, QR code, and publication details for "2-8 NOVEMBER 2020" are visible at the bottom.
